Canadian Spine Society

24th Annual Scientific Conference

Wednesday, February 28 – Saturday, March 2

Fairmont Chateau Whistler, Whistler, B.C., Canada

Abstracts

analysis.description: This document contains the abstracts from the 24th Annual Scientific Conference of the Canadian Spine Society, held from February 28 to March 2 at the Fairmont Chateau Whistler, Whistler, B.C., Canada.

type.justification: Conference abstracts generally present empirical research findings.

name.justification: The focus is on spinal health and related medical studies within the Canadian Spine Society context.
Spine studies are closely related to orthopedics.
Spine research often intersects with neurosurgery.
Spine studies often include aspects of rehabilitation science.
